entities.summary: John Huston Ricard, SSJ, is an American Catholic prelate who served as bishop of Pensacola-Tallahassee in Florida from 1997 to 2011 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Baltimore in Maryland from 1984 to 1997.
